# apple_app_settings (Resource)

Manages an app's settings: primary locale, bundle ID, content rights, accessibility URL and App Store Server Notifications URLs. Apps cannot be created through the API, so this manages an existing app; unset arguments keep their current values, and destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_settings" "example" {
  app_id                          = data.apple_app.example.id
  primary_locale                  = "en-US"
  content_rights_declaration      = "DOES_NOT_USE_THIRD_PARTY_CONTENT"
  subscription_status_url         = "https://example.com/app-store/notifications"
  subscription_status_url_version = "V2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `accessibility_url` (String) URL of the app's accessibility information.
- `bundle_id` (String) Bundle identifier of the app.
- `content_rights_declaration` (String) Whether the app uses third-party content: `DOES_NOT_USE_THIRD_PARTY_CONTENT`, `USES_THIRD_PARTY_CONTENT`.
- `primary_locale` (String) Primary locale, e.g. `en-US`. The app needs an `apple_app_info_localization` for it.
- `streamlined_purchasing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether streamlined purchasing is enabled.
- `subscription_status_url` (String) URL that receives App Store Server Notifications.
- `subscription_status_url_for_sandbox` (String) URL that receives sandbox App Store Server Notifications.
- `subscription_status_url_version` (String) Version of those notifications: `V1`, `V2`.
- `subscription_status_url_version_for_sandbox` (String) Version of the sandbox notifications: `V1`, `V2`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_settings.example
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_settings.example 1234567890
```
